purpose: The single source of truth for the npm test failures the owner has accepted as open on the default build. It replaces the list that had to be combined from docs/plans/hull-set-v1.md Appendix A, its renames and the removals noted in docs/STATUS.md. A full default-build npm test must fail exactly the tests in `failures`: a new failing name is a regression, and a recorded name that passes must leave this file in the same change. Each entry names its first failing assertion (`first_failing_assertion`, file:line) and that assertion's message (`first_failing_message`, the error's first line); scripts/reconcile-failures.mjs compares a saved npm test log against this file by name AND first assertion, so a new earlier failure inside a recorded test reads as MOVED, not as the recorded one (AUD-05).

classes.A: Stale pin: an exact value or a source identifier moved; re-pinned to the value the repository has.
classes.B: Obsolete: the test checked behaviour that an owner decision or a merged task deliberately changed; rewritten to the rule in force, or retired.
classes.C: Real defect: the game or a tool behaves wrongly, or a gate is genuinely violated. Not re-pinned.
classes.D: Harness or environment: the test's own fixture, a stale committed evidence file or model, or the machine.
classes.E: Unknown: bounded source/history inspection and reproduction do not yet distinguish stale expectations, fixture problems and real defects.
